quality.reason: The report is well-formatted with scores, dollar values, and links, but it leaks internal chain-of-thought ('Now format the Discord report...') into the output and largely repackages the public @whale_alert bot feed, adding only marginal curation value over the source.

Well-structured with genuinely actionable data (PnL, win rate, signal strengths with sources), but the truncated news section, empty [[]] link placeholders, and all signals being sub-0.5 strength temper its immediate actionable value.

Well-structured output with a genuinely actionable signal — the BTC 'WRONG STRAT' flag with negative margin and declining score clearly indicates a strategy switch is needed, while trend deltas and margins for other pairs provide real decision-support context.

Well-structured output with actionable alerts (HYPE/TAO orderbook imbalance corroborated by elevated funding rates), clean multi-metric table, and clear timestamp, though it could add threshold context or trend history for even more signal.

Well-structured daily review with quantified trends, specific failing components (meta-agent broken 130d, 0% uptime endpoints, 66% scanner volume collapse), and clear portfolio status that together give multiple concrete actionable signals.

Well-structured output with transparent methodology disclosure (API fallback documented) and a clearly relevant paper selection matching the scan scope, but the truncated view prevents verifying paper summaries, link validity, and overall completeness needed for full actionable value.

issues: Verification date (2026-08-19) is self-declared and cannot be independently confirmed from the content provided

Reliance on niche single-maintainer Homebrew taps (antonriorodr/memo, steipete/tap/remindctl, steipete/tap/imsg) that are prone to abandonment, renames, or dead tap URLs; 'remindctl' in particular is not a widely known tool and may have been superseded (e.g., keith/reminders-cli is the more established Reminders CLI)

Permission guidance 'System Settings → Privacy → Automation' is inaccurate on modern macOS: Automation access is granted via per-app prompt on first AppleScript use and managed under Privacy & Security → Automation, not pre-granted from that path; the section also omits the '& Security' rename
Header promises AppleScript-based control but no AppleScript examples appear in the excerpt; unclear if the deprecated-pattern risk (raw osascript) is documented in the truncated remainder
Content is truncated at 2000 chars mid-sentence in the imsg 'Permission' section, so freshness of the remaining sections and the references/ files cannot be assessed
Status block itself notes memo and remindctl are NOT installed on the verified machine, so two of three tools' commands are untested as of the verification date and could fail on install or first run
No URLs or versioned API references appear in the excerpt, so dead-link/deprecation checks are not applicable — freshness cannot be fully verified

Claim 'Claude was trained on both' (element indices and coordinates) is inaccurate: Claude's computer-use training uses Anthropic's native screenshot+coordinate schema; Set-of-Mark/AX indices are a prompting-layer convention, not trained behavior

Tool signature (computer_use with mode=som|vision|ax, element=N, capture_after=True) matches no public SDK or standard; it appears bespoke, so parameter names may have drifted from the actual implementation and should be verified against the current tool schema

Model references are generic (Claude, GPT, Gemini, OpenAI-compatible endpoints); if the underlying stack ever targeted OpenAI's computer-use-preview/CUA endpoint, note that it was retired and integrations should use current Responses API tooling
